rationale: The HN thread shows genuine curiosity about AI subscription spend, but with only 8 points and 22 comments the signal is thin. Multiple free alternatives (spreadsheets, manual tracking, existing SaaS spend-trackers like Ramp or Notion templates) already absorb this pain at zero marginal cost, and the thread yields no willingness-to-pay signal — users are sharing spend figures, not asking for a paid tool to manage it. The 5-distinct-pain-quotes bar and at least 1 WTP signal cannot be met from available evidence.
